'''Iraklis F.C.''',<ref>{{Cite web |title=Iraklis FC {{!}} UEFA |url=https://www.uefa.com/nationalassociations/teams/59868 |access-date=2025-05-04 |website=UEFA.com}}</ref> also known as '''Iraklis VENETIS BAKERIES''' after its title sponsor,<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |date=24 July 2024 |title=Η ΣΥΝΕΝΤΕΥΞΗ ΤΥΠΟΥ ΓΙΑ ΤΗΝ ΠΑΕ ΠΟΤ ΗΡΑΚΛΗΣ-ΦΟΥΡΝΟΙ ΒΕΝΕΤΗ |url=https://iraklis-fc.com/i-synentefxi-typou-tou-panagioti-monemvasioti |access-date=15 October 2024 |website=FC Iraklis}}</ref> is a professional [[Football club (association football)|football club]] based in the city of [[Thessaloniki]], [[Macedonia (Greece)|Macedonia]], Greece. Created in 1908, it serves as the professional [[Association football|men's football]] department of the multisports club of [[G.S. Iraklis Thessaloniki]]s. They play their home matches at [[Kaftanzoglio Stadium]]. As of 2026, the club competes in the [[Greek football league system|first–tier level]] [[Super League Greece|Super League 1]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Επίσημα στοιχεία ΗΡΑΚΛΗΣ 2026-2027 {{!}} Super League Ελλάδα |url=https://www.slgr.gr/el/team/10 |access-date=2026-10-03 |website=www.slgr.gr}}</ref>

[[G.S. Iraklis Thessaloniki]]s was founded on 29 November 1908 and is one of the oldest and most historic sport clubs in Greece, hence the nickname "Gireos" ({{Langx|el|Γηραιός|4=Elder}}). In 1910, the name "Iraklís" ({{Langx|el|Ηρακλής|4=Heracles}}, {{IPA|el|iɾa'klis}}) was added to the club's name as an honour to the [[Greek mythology|ancient Greek]] [[demigod]] [[Heracles]] (or [[Hercules]] as the [[Interpretatio graeca|Roman equivalent]]), hence the nickname "Imitheos" ({{Langx|el|Ημίθεος|4=Demigod}}). The club's colours are blue and white, inspired by the [[flag of Greece]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Ιστορία - Γ.Σ. Ηρακλής |url=https://iraklis.club/history |access-date=2025-05-05 |website=Γ.Σ. Ηρακλής - Επίσημο site του ερασιτέχνη Ηρακλή}}</ref>

Iraklis Thessaloniki is a founding member of [[Macedonia Football Clubs Association]] and [[Hellenic Football Federation]]. Before the formation of the nationwide league of [[Super League Greece|Alpha Ethniki]], Iraklis Thessaloniki competed in the league that was run by the [[Macedonia Football Clubs Association]], winning it on 5 occasions. The club has also played in 5 [[Greek Football Cup|Greek Cup]] finals, lifting the trophy once in [[1975–76 Greek Football Cup|1976]], which is the club's only domestic trophy. They have also a European trophy, the [[Balkans Cup]], won  in [[1984–85 Balkans Cup|1985]]."}}
